description: Use this when someone wants to find original paintings, prints, photographs or sculpture from independent artists by subject, style, colour, size or budget. It returns only works that meet everything asked for, each with what it met; works that meet only part come back separately as near_matches, each saying what it misses. A request can be written in words ("a large blue abstract painting under $2,000") or sent as filters — min_price_usd, max_price_usd, orientation, subject, style, medium, colors, min_height_in, max_height_in, min_width_in, max_width_in, ships_to, framed, ready_to_hang, signed, edition — and a filter wins over the same thing read from the words. applied_filters lists every constraint used and where it came from; check it, and correct a misreading with a filter. A word about the work that names no constraint must appear in its own words to match ("lighthouse"). Words of mood ("calm") and of where it will hang ("hallway", "above the sofa") only order the results; words of how it will be used ("to hang", "a gift") are not used, and only "ready to hang" filters. A place it ships to, with its state or ZIP ("ships to Austin, Texas"), is read as ships_to. understood says how each word was used. This catalogue CANNOT be filtered by authenticity or provenance strength: Fold verifies sellers, not works (see _verification). Works on sale now are returned; include_sold adds sold works. Attributes are as the seller stated them, and a null means unspecified, never estimated. completeness says whether every work was checked. A wall — wall: {width, height, furniture_width, furniture_height, unit} — keeps only works whose size suits it by Fold’s rules of thumb; find_artworks_for_wall gives the range and why. similar_to {artwork_id | image_url | image_base64} keeps only works that look like it, at or above Fold’s similarity threshold, the closest first.

colors.description: Every one of these among the colours the seller confirmed for the work.

edition.description: unique: one of a kind; edition: one impression of an edition.

framed.description: Framed (true) or unframed (false), as the seller stated.

include_sold.description: Also include works that have already sold. Off by default. Works taken off sale are never returned either way.

max_height_in.description: Height at most this, in inches.

max_price_usd.description: Highest acceptable price, in US dollars.

max_width_in.description: Width at most this, in inches.

medium.description: Any of these media; a family such as painting or print includes its members.

min_height_in.description: Height at least this, in inches.

min_price_usd.description: Lowest acceptable price, in US dollars.

min_width_in.description: Width at least this, in inches.

orientation.description: Any of: portrait (taller than wide), landscape (wider than tall), square.

query.description: What the buyer is looking for, in their words.

ready_to_hang.description: Ready to hang, as the seller stated.

ships_to.description: Where the buyer wants it delivered. Fold delivers to the 50 US states and DC.

region.description: The state, e.g. CO or Colorado.

signed.description: Signed by the artist, as the seller stated.

similar_to.description: A work, or a photo, the works must look like.

artwork_id.description: A work on Fold to find works like: an artwork_id from search_artworks.

image_base64.description: A photo to find works like, inline: a JPEG, PNG or WebP as base64 or a data: URL, at most 700 KB. Used for this search only, and kept nowhere.

image_url.description: A photo to find works like: its https address. Fetched once, used for this search only, and kept nowhere.

wall.description: The wall the work will hang on: only works whose size suits it.

furniture_height.description: The furniture’s height from the floor, to hang the work above it. Give it with furniture_width.

furniture_width.description: The width of the furniture the work will hang above — a sofa, a bed, a sideboard — if any.

height.description: The wall’s height from the floor, in `unit`.

name: search_artworks
title: Search artworks
